features.name: Text Content
features.details: SimpleMentionsInput contentEditable div accepts and displays text input

features.name: @Mentions
features.details: Dropdown appears on @, supports 4 entity types (user/event/group/city), colored pills inserted

features.name: Location Tagging
features.details: Opens recommendation panel with UnifiedLocationPicker, 3-tier search (City Groups > Popular > Nominatim)

features.name: Visibility Options
features.details: Three options: public/friends/private, friends includes closeness filter, context-aware defaults
features.dataConnection: N/A - Local state, saved with post

features.name: Memory Tags
features.details: 15 predefined tags with Lucide icons: Travel, Food, Culture, Adventure, Nightlife, Nature, Art, Music, Sports, Photography, Family, Friends, Work, Milestone, Celebration

features.name: Recommendations
features.details: 6 categories (Restaurant, Café, Hotel, Tango Venue, Activity, Bar) + 4 price ranges ($, $$, $$$, $$$$)

features.name: Media Upload
features.details: Accepts images and videos, max 30 files, smart compression based on file size, video server-side compression

features.name: AI Enhancement
features.details: Button visible but disabled when no content. When enabled, calls AI API for content enhancement. Shows enhanced version panel.
features.notes: Requires text content to enable button

features.name: Cross-posting
features.details: Facebook and Instagram toggle switches visible, status indicators for pending/success/error

features.name: Submit Post
features.details: Share Memory button visible, disabled when no content, creates post on API, invalidates caches

features.name: Edit Mode
features.details: Component accepts editMode and existingPost props, populates all fields, uses PATCH for updates
features.testId: N/A - Uses same UI with different behavior

features.name: Context Types
features.details: Supports feed, event, group, city, memory contexts. Context-aware visibility defaults and auto-mentions

issues.description: Test ID not forwarded from PostCreator to SimpleMentionsInput
issues.details: PostCreator passes data-testid='input-post-content' but SimpleMentionsInput uses data-testid='input-mentions-content'
